cardOverview.overviewText: A RuPay Platinum variant from HSBC with elevated rewards, travel perks, and lifestyle benefits for frequent domestic users.

benefitRows.name: Cleartrip
benefitRows.offer: Avail up to ₹6,000 off on flights and hotel bookings.
benefitRows.howToAvail: To avail the HSBC RuPay Platinum Credit Card's Cleartrip offer on International Flights, simply make a booking of INR 15,000 or more on the Cleartrip website or app. During checkout, apply the promocode HSBCRPCC and complete the transaction using your HSBC RuPay Platinum Credit Card to receive a flat 10% discount, capped at a maximum of INR 6,000. This offer is valid once per user per product.

benefitRows.name: Paytm
benefitRows.offer: 5% off on transactions of Rs. 299 and above on bill payments- mobile (prepaid and postpaid), broadband, DTH, water bills, gas cylinders, piped gas bills, FASTag and electricity bills; capped at Rs. 150
benefitRows.howToAvail: To avail the HSBC RuPay Platinum Credit Card's Paytm offer, simply make an eligible bill payment of INR 299 or more on the Paytm app or website. During checkout, apply the promocode HSBC150 and complete the transaction using your HSBC RuPay Platinum Credit Card to receive a 5% discount, capped at a maximum of INR 150, once per month.
